job.job_description:
Required Skills:



5+ years of experience in Python Full Stack Development.
Strong hands-on experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Strong experience with React.js or Angular.
Good experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Strong experience developing REST APIs and Microservices.
Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services.
Experience with Git, unit testing, and CI/CD.
Good understanding of OOP, data structures, and software design principles.



Good to Have:



Docker/Kubernetes
Redis/Kafka/RabbitMQ
Terraform/CloudFormation
AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, EC2, RDS
Exposure to GenAI/AI/ML technologies



Experience: 5+ Years

Role: Senior Python Full Stack Developer

Location: Chennai




Were conducting an in-person interview drive on Saturday, 10th October 2026 in Chennai Office. If you're interested in exploring this opportunity, please share your updated CV at anup_goud@epam.com and feel free to contact me at 9346352967 for more details.
